name: Idorsia Ltd
summary: Idorsia Ltd, a biopharmaceutical company, engages in the discovery, development, and commercialization of drugs for unmet medical needs in Switzerland, the United States, Japan, Europe, China, and Canada. The company has a clinical development pipeline for various therapeutic areas, such as CNS, cardiovascular, immunological disorders, and orphan diseases. It offers QUVIVIQ (daridorexant) for the treatment of insomnia.
